── 2. Window Management ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + Q                 close focused window
  super + shift + Q         close focused window
  super + shift + Space     toggle floating
  super + F                 toggle fullscreen
  super + alt + F           maximize
  super + P                 pseudo-tile
  super + G                 toggle group
  super + Left/Right/Up/Down       focus window in direction
  super + shift + Left/Right/Up/Down   swap window in direction
  super + ctrl + Left/Right/Up/Down    move window into group in direction
  super + shift + H         shrink window width
  super + shift + L         grow window width
  super + shift + K         shrink window height
  super + shift + J         grow window height
  super + Left-drag         move window (mouse)
  super + Right-drag        resize window (mouse)

── 3. Workspaces / Tags / Groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + 1..0              switch to workspace 1–10
  super + ctrl + 1..0       move window to workspace 1–10 (follow)
  super + shift + 1..0      send window to workspace 1–10 (silent)
  super + period            next workspace
  super + comma             previous workspace
  super + Tab               next workspace
  super + shift + Tab       previous workspace
  super + scroll            cycle workspaces
  super + U                 toggle scratchpad (special workspace)
  super + shift + U         send window to scratchpad

── 4. Layout & Tiling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + J                 toggle split direction
  super + I                 add window to master
  super + ctrl + Return     swap with master

── 6. Multimedia & Hardware ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  XF86AudioRaiseVolume      volume up (wpctl +5%)
  XF86AudioLowerVolume      volume down (wpctl -5%)
  XF86AudioMute             toggle mute (wpctl)
  XF86AudioPlay             play / pause (playerctl)
  XF86AudioNext             next track (playerctl)
  XF86AudioPrev             previous track (playerctl)
  XF86MonBrightnessUp       brightness up (brightnessctl)
  XF86MonBrightnessDown     brightness down (brightnessctl)

── 7. Screenshots ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Print                     region screenshot → clipboard (grim + slurp)
  super + Print             full screen → clipboard (grim)

── 8. System & Session ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + X                 archlinux-logout (logout menu)
  ctrl + alt + K            archlinux-logout (logout menu)
  ctrl + alt + L            archlinux-logout --settings (logout settings)
  super + shift + X         kiro-powermenu (power menu)
  ctrl + alt + R            archlinux-betterlockscreen (set lockscreen wallpaper)
  super + Escape            hyprctl kill (kill mode)
  super + ctrl + S          show keybindings
  super + shift + R         reload Hyprland config
